original.verbatim:
INT. ARGUS HQ - NIGHT

A dimly lit office space with high-tech computers and gadgets scattered all over the room. The ARGUS logo is displayed on one of the walls. AMANDA WALLER - or at least what looks like her - is seated in a leather chair behind a large, modern desk, surrounded by framed photos of her career highlights.

BATMAN (early 40s, strong but weathered) is standing in front of the desk, his cape barely touching the floor. Their faces are intense, the tension between them palpable. The only audible sound is the hum of the equipment.

AMANDA WALLER
(leaning forward)
You know, Batman, it's not every day that someone like you comes knocking on ARGUS's door.

BATMAN
(snarky)
I don't knock. And don't think your Task Force X has gone unnoticed.

AMANDA WALLER
(smirking)
I gathered as much. But I needed them. There are some threats that even the Justice League can't be seen handling.

BATMAN
You mean you want us to be your scapegoats. We're not your pawns, Waller.

AMANDA WALLER
(boldly)
But you could be. It doesn't take a genius to see that the world is going to hell in a handbasket. Those monsters that were unleashed, the rise in metahuman activity. We need to be prepared for anything.

Suddenly, Amanda Waller's features start to distort, her face becoming less human-like, the wrinkles and texture slowly disappearing. She seems to be struggling, her body trembling.

With a gasp, Wonder Woman (early 30s, strong and fierce) bursts out of the synthetic bodysuit of Amanda Waller, violently tearing it apart. The shredded, lifeless bodysuit now lays scattered across the floor.

As Batman looks on, shocked, Wonder Woman stands up, attempting to catch her breath.

BATMAN
(concerned)
Diana! What just happened?

WONDER WOMAN
(exhaling)
It was an elaborate trap... I was lured into it by someone posing as Amanda Waller. They must have planted the synthetic bodysuit afterward to continue using her appearance for their purpose.

BATMAN
(growing angrier)
Do you know who's responsible?

WONDER WOMAN
(shaking her head)
No. But we must find the real Amanda Waller and whoever did this before they cause any more damage.

Batman gives a determined nod as he and Wonder Woman prepare to leave the room, knowing that they must uncover the truth and stop whoever is hiding behind the synthetic Amanda Waller.

FADE OUT.
